import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { readFileSync, readdirSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import type { T3Database } from './connection.js';

export interface MigrationResult {
  applied: number[];
  currentVersion: number;
}

interface AppliedMigration {
  version: number;
  name: string;
  checksum: string;
}

interface MigrationFile extends AppliedMigration {
  sql: string;
  compatibleChecksums: string[];
}

const defaultMigrationsDirectory = fileURLToPath(new URL('./migrations/', import.meta.url));

function migrationChecksums(sql: string): string[] {
  const lfSql = sql.replace(/\r\n?/gu, '\n');
  const crlfSql = lfSql.replace(/\n/gu, '\r\n');
  return [...new Set([lfSql, crlfSql, sql].map((value) => (
    createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex')
  )))];
}

function loadMigrations(directory: string): MigrationFile[] {
  const migrations = readdirSync(directory)
    .filter((name) => /^\d+_[^/\\]+\.sql$/.test(name))
    .map((name) => {
      const version = Number.parseInt(name.split('_', 1)[0] ?? '', 10);
      const sql = readFileSync(join(directory, name), 'utf8');
      const compatibleChecksums = migrationChecksums(sql);
      return {
        version,
        name,
        checksum: compatibleChecksums[0]!,
        compatibleChecksums,
        sql,
      };
    })
    .sort((left, right) => left.version - right.version);

  const versions = new Set<number>();
  for (const migration of migrations) {
    if (versions.has(migration.version)) {
      throw new Error(`duplicate migration version ${migration.version}`);
    }
    versions.add(migration.version);
  }

  return migrations;
}

export function applyAllMigrations(
  database: T3Database,
  directory = defaultMigrationsDirectory,
): MigrationResult {
  database.exec(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_migrations (
      version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      checksum TEXT NOT NULL,
      applied_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    );
  `);

  const appliedRows = database
    .prepare('SELECT version, name, checksum FROM schema_migrations ORDER BY version')
    .all() as AppliedMigration[];
  const appliedByVersion = new Map(appliedRows.map((migration) => [migration.version, migration]));
  const migrations = loadMigrations(directory);
  const applied: number[] = [];

  for (const migration of migrations) {
    const existing = appliedByVersion.get(migration.version);
    if (existing) {
      if (existing.name !== migration.name || !migration.compatibleChecksums.includes(existing.checksum)) {
        throw new Error(`migration ${migration.version} checksum mismatch`);
      }
      continue;
    }

    database.transaction(() => {
      database.exec(migration.sql);
      database.prepare(
        'INSERT INTO schema_migrations (version, name, checksum) VALUES (?, ?, ?)',
      ).run(migration.version, migration.name, migration.checksum);
    })();
    applied.push(migration.version);
  }

  const currentVersion = database
    .prepare('SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM schema_migrations')
    .pluck()
    .get() as number;

  return { applied, currentVersion };
}

# T³ Agent Guardrails

T³ is a lightweight personal collection index.

For the live implementation boundary read `CURRENT.md`; unfinished offline features and grouped App acceptance are tracked in `docs/offline-completion-status.md`. These are operational status, not replacements for the guardrails below.

Current data model: Entry and Producer are the core subjects. `Entry.type` supplies classification. Collections (migration `010_collections.sql`) are lightweight user-curated folders of Entries or Producers — the only stored grouping subject; Gallery itself remains a read-time projection of `Entry.type`, never a table. Entry and Producer tags use separate vocabularies. Entry tags always belong to Facets, and Facets always belong to Sections of the same Entry type. See `docs/current-architecture.md`.

Product priorities:
1. fast daily use
2. tag-first navigation
3. local ownership
4. source independence
5. progressive complexity

Never introduce database-platform features without explicit request. Do not expose database terminology in normal UI. Do not add formula systems, generic tables, project management, PKM features, media playback, downloads, or web-wide crawling.

All schema changes require a new immutable migration. Never change the schema merely to simplify frontend code.

Before UI work that depends on new database behavior:
1. add/review the migration;
2. update `db:probe`;
3. add real-SQL integration tests;
4. run `db:doctor`;
5. only then implement UI.

Tests must never touch `.data/library.db`. Use isolated in-memory databases for repository behavior and temporary file databases for WAL, backups, migration fixtures, and corruption/doctor tests.

# T³ Agent Guardrails

T³ is a lightweight personal collection index.

For the live implementation boundary read `CURRENT.md`; unfinished offline features and grouped App acceptance are tracked in `docs/offline-completion-status.md`. These are operational status, not replacements for the guardrails below.

Current data model: Entry and Producer are the core subjects. `Entry.type` supplies classification. Collections (migration `010_collections.sql`) are lightweight user-curated folders of Entries or Producers — the only stored grouping subject; Gallery itself remains a read-time projection of `Entry.type`, never a table. Entry and Producer tags use separate vocabularies. Entry tags always belong to Facets, and Facets always belong to Sections of the same Entry type. See `docs/current-architecture.md`.

Product priorities:
1. fast daily use
2. tag-first navigation
3. local ownership
4. source independence
5. progressive complexity

Never introduce database-platform features without explicit request. Do not expose database terminology in normal UI. Do not add formula systems, generic tables, project management, PKM features, media playback, downloads, or web-wide crawling.

All schema changes require a new immutable migration. Never change the schema merely to simplify frontend code.

Before UI work that depends on new database behavior:
1. add/review the migration;
2. update `db:probe`;
3. add real-SQL integration tests;
4. run `db:doctor`;
5. only then implement UI.

Tests must never touch `.data/library.db`. Use isolated in-memory databases for repository behavior and temporary file databases for WAL, backups, migration fixtures, and corruption/doctor tests.

### 侧边栏大改：搜索框与 Home 行移除、三个图标门、交换模式（含一条新 migration）（2026-10-06）

用户：**「1，移除目前的搜索框和 home gallery。2，icon 文件夹里存有 search, homepage, exchange 三个图标……
在我标记的三个蓝点处，从左到右依次为 search homepage exchange 的位置……3，对于新加的 exchange 功能，
用于点击后可以移动 gallery 在列表里的上下位置。可以就用 collection 里移动文件夹的上下箭头。这是编辑
切换键，所以其动效应该是点击后颜色加深表示状态应用（参考 view later 按钮），search 和 homepage 只需要
有点击那一下的动画就可以了。4，移除搜索框后侧边栏相当于多了一大行，可以考虑再给 gallery 列表多加 1-2 行」**

**这次动到了数据库 —— 因为"移动 gallery 的顺序"在库里根本无处可存。**

```text
  Gallery 是 entries.type 的读时投影，不是表；listGalleries 一直是 ORDER BY type COLLATE NOCASE
  → 顺序只是字母序，没有任何地方能记住"我要 Comic 在 Hentai 上面"
  所以按 AGENTS.md 的顺序做了一整套：
    036_gallery_order.sql（新表，稀疏：只有被移动过的 type 才有行）
    → db:probe 加了一条 schema-36 检查（由 integration 测试在一次性库上跑到 ✓）
    → 真 SQL integration 测试（4 条：默认字母序 / 记住顺序且新 gallery 排最后 / 整表替换 / 拒绝重复或空名）
    → listGalleries 读顺序 → API PUT /api/galleries/order（整份列表，不是交换两个）
```

**为什么写整份列表**：交换相邻两行会让其余 gallery 留在字母序里 —— 那是一个看列表猜不出来的顺序。整份写入
让顺序成为**全序**，而之后新建的 gallery 没有行、自然排在末尾 ✓。

**UI**：

```text
  · 搜索框与 Home 行移除；三个图标门放进 "Your Galleries" 那一行（44px 触摸目标，正合用户画的蓝点位置）
  · search / homepage：点击反馈是按下时 scale(0.9)
  · exchange：**模式键**，打开时用与 view-later 同一套"已应用"外观（accent 描边 + accent-soft 底），
    aria-pressed 跟着变；打开后每行出现 Collections 页同款的 ↑ ↓ 箭头（首尾自动禁用）
  · 移动是**先本地后落盘**：行跟着手指走，写失败就退回并报错，而不是让侧边栏显示一个库里没有的顺序
  · 图标按 icons.ts 的既有风格手描（24×24、2 单位描边、currentColor），母版就是 apps/web/icon 里那两张 PNG
```

实测（390×844 抽屉 / 1280×800 桌面）：

### 回答"手机端的规格是不是硬编码"：不是按机型，但断点有四套；实测揪出 761–936px 的溢出窗口（2026-10-06）

用户：**「目前手机端的各种规格是不是都是 hard code 的？换个手机大小显示如何？」**

先查再量。

**不是按机型硬编码。** 全仓没有一处 UA/机型分支；布局用的是 `1fr`、`minmax(0,…)`、`rem`、
百分比、`min(20rem, calc(100vw - 3rem))`（侧栏）、`env(safe-area-inset-*)`。固定的只有两类，都是有意为之：
**触摸目标 44px** 和**断点**。

**但断点确实有四套，而且不一致**（这就是"硬编码"真正的所在）：

```text
  44rem (704px)  15 处  —— 主体（外壳、主题、大多数页面）
  760px           2 处  —— AddEntryPage / AddAuthorPage  ← 只有这两页
  52rem / 64rem   6 处  —— 平板 / 桌面
  30 / 34 / 38rem 9 处  —— 窄机微调
```

**实测（内置浏览器，逐个宽度 reload 后量 `document.scrollWidth` 与越界元素）**：

```text
  宽度    320   360   390   430   730   768   844   920
  横向溢出  无    无    无    无    无    **有**  **有**   **有**
  768 时：文档要 936px，34 个元素越界，字段输入框右边缘到 852
```

**手机范围内（320–430）本来就是好的** —— 没有溢出、五个标签全部可达、标签栏可横滑。

**761–936px 才是坏的**（平板竖屏 / 手机横屏），原因是**这一页自己的断点比它的桌面排版所需还窄**：

```text
  两列表单最小 = 240(媒体列) + 280(字段列) + 24(gap) + 40(卡片内边距) = 584px
  外壳在 44rem(704) 之前保留 288px 侧栏 → 两列需要 584 + 288 + 24 + 16 + 24 ≈ **936px**
  而 AddEntryPage 的单列断点是 760px —— 761~936 这段"既不是移动也不是桌面"
  （760 这个数字像是"没有侧栏时表单需要的宽度"，不是"有侧栏时"）
```

```text

  offline-api.ts:1170
      const generation = await store.readMeta(ACTIVE_GENERATION_KEY);
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(generation) || generation <= 0) return false;
      setMode('offline');          ← 冷启动**故意**先切到本地快照（免得页面空白）

      usageOf(entry.id).lastViewedAt —— 用的是**快照自己的**使用记录，也就是上次同步时的
```

```ts
watch(() => props.offlineState?.mode, ...)   // GalleryApp.vue:2379
  if (activeType.value !== null) refreshes.push(loadGalleryEntries());
  if (activeEntry.value !== null) refreshes.push(reloadActiveEntry());
```

null，所以别处零成本。

守卫：`gallery-app.test::re-reads Home when the app comes back online, instead of keeping the snapshot

3:/**
4: * The order the sidebar lists Galleries in.
5: *
6: * A Gallery is a projection of `entries.type`, so it has no row of its own and the list used to fall
7: * back to the alphabet — stable, but not the person's order: measured on a real library with seven
8: * galleries, the two used every day sat wherever their spelling put them and there was no way to move
9: * one. This is that order, stored sparsely per type.
10: *
11: * The write is the **whole list**, not a pair of neighbours, and that is deliberate: a swap of two
12: * rows leaves every other Gallery in the alphabet, which is an order nobody can predict from looking
13: * at it. Writing all of them makes the order total, and a Gallery created later simply has no row and
14: * sorts after the ones that do.
15: */
16:export function listGalleryOrder(database: T3Database): string[] {
17:  return database.prepare(`
18:    SELECT entry_type
19:    FROM gallery_order
20:    ORDER BY sort_order, entry_type COLLATE NOCASE
21:  `).pluck().all() as string[];
22:}
24:/** Writes the order as given, in one transaction: the list a person sees becomes the list stored. */
25:export function setGalleryOrder(database: T3Database, entryTypes: string[]): string[] {
26:  const types: string[] = [];
27:  for (const raw of entryTypes) {
28:    const type = raw.trim();
29:    // One Gallery appears once, and an empty name is not a Gallery: a list that repeats or empties
30:    // itself would be written as an order with a hole in it.
31:    if (type === '' || types.includes(type)) {
32:      throw new Error(`Gallery order must name each Gallery once: ${JSON.stringify(raw)}`);
33:    }
34:    types.push(type);
35:  }
36:  return database.transaction(() => {
37:    database.prepare('DELETE FROM gallery_order').run();
38:    const insert = database.prepare(
39:      'INSERT INTO gallery_order (entry_type, sort_order) VALUES (?, ?)',
40:    );
41:    types.forEach((type, index) => insert.run(type, index));
42:    return types;
43:  })();
44:}
